evals.prompt: I've been adding skills to .claude/skills but .gemini/skills is out of sync. Run skill-transfer to compare .claude and .gemini, show me what needs to be transferred, and flag any conflicts.
evals.expected_output: A concise report showing: summary stats, auto-resolvable skills (already synced + new to migrate), and any conflicts with enumerated decision points (1.A, 2.B format)

evals.prompt: I'm consolidating my agent setup. Scan .claude/skills, .gemini/skills, and .agents/skills. Show me the full picture: what's in common, what's unique to each, and what has conflicts. Focus only on claude and gemini repos.
evals.expected_output: Report showing total discovered skills, breakdown of synced vs new vs conflicts. Clear summary of what each repo has and what needs attention.

evals.prompt: I updated search-web in .claude/skills (v1.2) but .gemini still has v1.0. Show me the conflict and explain what's different so I can decide which version to keep. Also show me all other skills that are already synced across both.
evals.expected_output: Report highlighting the search-web conflict with version info and key differences, plus list of already-synced skills. Clear decision point format.
